messages:
sophia: Following the postmortem, I'm consolidating the GPU capacity + autoscale remediation list. Need a single-line owner, ETA, and one-line rollback for SRE. I'll import to the tracker at EOD.

mike: I can take scheduler tuning. Will test fair_share variations and preemption thresholds, plus a canary plan. ETA: 9 business days. Rollback: revert scheduler config to last stable commit and disable scheduler feature flag.

raj: I'll own quota engagement with cloud vendor + sales fallback for reserved capacity. Filing support request now. ETA: 2 business days to file request. Rollback: enable reserved burst capacity and route affected tenants to alternate region if vendor blocks.

_tess: I'll implement a lightweight staging canary (10%) and add a p99 alert + dashboard tile. ETA: 3 days. Rollback: mute canary split and revert routing; run quick smoke to confirm baseline.

nate: I'll draft a short emergency headroom play and propose a surge oncall rota. Will include exact console paths for toggles. ETA: 5 days. Rollback: console steps to reduce max_instances and enable throttles for low-priority lanes.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-4520 \u2014 "GPU surge quota & autoscale follow-up" (assignee: raj). https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-4520

mike: Canary details: start with internal traffic, compare p50/p95/p99 and error rates. Canary 10% for 48h; if p99 improves widen to 25%. If errors increase -> rollback.

tess: PromQL for proposed p99 alert:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, tenant))
```
Alert: p99 > 450ms for 10m -> page oncall. Will add canary vs baseline panel.

raj: Vendor path: open support + vendor quota form. If approval delayed, coordinate with Sales to enable reserved capacity for short window and notify customers.

nate: Emergency play (short): 1) Auto-route low-priority tenants to quantized model; 2) Increase autoscale max_instances if quota allows + enable pre-warmed pool for 20m; 3) Flip experimental preempt flag OFF; 4) If saturated -> enable reserved capacity via Sales and apply low-priority throttles.

sophia: TL;DR for tracker: quota=raj (2d, INF-4520), scheduler=mike (9bd), canary+alert=tess (3d), runbook+nights=nate (5d). Please paste the 1-line rollback here so SRE can act during incidents.

mike: rollback posted above.

raj: rollback posted above.

_tess: rollback posted above.

nate: rollback posted; PR with runbook path will follow.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Postmortem actions: autoscale & quota" Wed 09:30  attendees: sophia, mike, raj, tess, nate

sophia: Thanks all  I'll update the remediation tracker and send a short summary + runbook link before the sync. Please post brief progress updates in this thread. :eyes:
